preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 512 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= R <= 8 and 1 <= C <= 8 and 1 <= K <= 8 for R, C, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For every test case, the row R, column C, and move limit K are integers between 1 and 8 inclusive.
The number of test case lines matches T.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == sum(1 for r in range(1, 9) for c in range(1, 9) if max(abs(r - R), abs(c - C)) <= K) for i, (R, C, K) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the count of squares (r, c) on the 8x8 board such that the Chebyshev distance from (R, C) to (r, c) is at most K.
